notes: Identity independently checked: title Motor Simulation Beyond the Dyad: Automatic Imitation of Multiple Actors; authors Emiel Cracco, Lize De Coster, Michael Andres, Marcel Brass; DOI 10.1037/a0039737 match the assigned reference. Author-uploaded primary article proof parsed from ResearchGate, not merely an abstract. Proof header has provisional issue/page metadata; proof pagination is used below. The frozen parse contains overlapping excerpts and ends mid-Experiment 2; Experiment 1 Method and relevant Results are present. No PDF supplied; no rendering possible. Only assigned unfinished fields assessed; remaining fields/sides are placeholders. Duplicate neutral descriptions have no contrast/hand-side discriminator. No assignment from audit ID, row order, or numeric matching. Error rows cite p. 5, which contains figures/discussion; numerical one-versus-two tests occur on proof p. 4. The one-versus-two ANOVA explicitly concerns IDENTICAL movements, not two DIFFERENT/conflicting movements. It reports main effects and an interaction, but the description does not select among these or specify an IC/IC versus single-incongruent-hand contrast. The different-movements subsection instead compares MEAN C/IC with N/N, not with one agent. Candidates below are not positive target extractions. Candidate identical-movements error tests: congruency F(1,37)=41.89, p<.001, d=1.05; hand-number F(1,37)=6.22, p=.017, d=0.41; interaction F(1,37)=14.02, p<.001, d=0.61. Candidate N=38 is the printed Experiment 1 participant count; no separate critical-test analytic N is stated. No participant-level exclusions explicitly stated. Trial exclusions are deadline exceeded 0.34% and RT<100 ms 0.05% in all analyses, plus erroneous trials 3.17% and RT>1000 ms 0.92% in RT analyses. No N derived from df or group sum.
